items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: he was with T-Garden, he went over with us that night

ctx.x: Don has a wonderful general style.

Well, Don told me, you know, when I talked to him down there at the beach with T-Garden, he was with T-Garden, he went over with us that night, he said, I said, I noticed you played some general stuff and featured it. He said, yes, I love that. I said, I made Jack, you know, I wanted to put that in the book. And he would tell me, he said, T-Garden, you know, it's pretty easy to work with that way. He says, anything that's good, he says, oh yeah, we'll do it. And that's all there is to it. So he played several…
